units.text: Dental care for the concerns that bring you to Neodent.

From dental implants and full mouth rehabilitation to orthodontic alignment, root canal treatment, crowns, dentures, veneers and smile-focused cosmetic dentistry, Neodent brings different areas of dental care together around the concerns that matter to each patient.
Dr. Md. Miftah Ur RahmanBDS · MDS · FICOI (U.S.A.) · Prosthodontist & Implantologist

Whether the concern is a missing tooth, damaged or worn teeth, tooth pain, difficulty chewing, changes in alignment or the appearance of a smile, the right treatment begins with understanding what is happening clinically and what the patient wants to achieve.

Every treatment begins with careful assessment rather than a one-size-fits-all approach. The condition of the teeth and gums, bite and function, existing dental work, overall oral health and the patient's treatment goals can all influence the treatment plan. Depending on the concern, care may involve restorative dentistry, prosthodontics, implant dentistry, orthodontics or cosmetic treatment, with the approach shaped around what is clinically appropriate.

For more complex concerns, treatment may involve several stages or more than one area of dentistry. Full mouth rehabilitation, for example, can require careful coordination of restorative and prosthodontic treatment to address multiple functional and dental concerns together. Similarly, replacing missing teeth with dental implants involves assessment, planning and restoration rather than simply placing an implant.

Across these treatments, Neodent's approach remains focused on clear clinical explanation, thoughtful planning and care that considers oral health, function and appearance together. With locations in Mehdipatnam and Nampally, Hyderabad, the practice provides access to a broad range of specialist-led dental treatment within the same clinical environment.

Neodent approaches different dental concerns through clinical assessment and treatment planning, drawing on a range of restorative, implant, orthodontic, prosthodontic and cosmetic treatment options. These featured treatments represent the primary clinical focuses at Neodent Dental Hospital, Mehdipatnam and Nampally.
Plan staged care when many teeth or the bite need attention.
Rebuild part of a damaged tooth with tooth-coloured composite resin.
Replace a missing tooth with an implant-supported crown, bridge or denture.
Treat infection or inflammation inside a tooth so it may be kept.
Gradually move teeth into position, then use retainers to help hold them.
Plan cosmetic options around the changes you want to make to your smile.
Smile Design & Cosmetic Dentistry in detail
Remove plaque and tartar, then polish the tooth surfaces.

Explore our treatments or speak with our team to understand your options.

Alongside the featured treatments, Neodent provides a broader range of restorative, cosmetic, preventive and surgical dental services. These services can form part of routine care or be considered alongside more comprehensive treatment, depending on the patient's clinical needs.
Specialist training in prosthodontics and implantology, and 30+ years of clinical practice, inform how Neodent assesses and plans treatment for each patient.
Specialist qualifications in prosthodontics and implantology, including FICOI (U.S.A.), underpin his approach to restorative and implant-based treatment at Neodent.
View Dr. Md. Miftah Ur Rahman’s profile

Treatment at Neodent begins with understanding the patient's concern. Not every dental condition requires the same response — some patients need care focused on a single affected tooth, while others may benefit from a more comprehensive treatment plan addressing multiple areas of the mouth.

Clinical assessment considers oral health, function and aesthetic goals together. Where appropriate, the team discusses suitable treatment options, explains what each approach involves, and helps patients understand the clinical considerations relevant to their condition.

Treatment planning at Neodent is not a fixed sequence — it is shaped by each patient's specific condition. The clinical team outlines available options, explains what each approach involves, and ensures that every decision is made with the patient's informed understanding.

How do I know which dental treatment I need?

Treatment recommendations are based on a clinical assessment of your dental condition. During a consultation, the dentist will evaluate your oral health and discuss suitable treatment options with you based on your specific concerns and goals.

Full mouth rehabilitation is a comprehensive approach to restoring oral health and function when multiple teeth are affected. It may involve a combination of treatments such as dental implants, crowns, bridges and other restorative procedures, planned together to address the overall condition.

Dental implants may be considered as a treatment option for replacing one or more missing teeth. The suitability of implants depends on factors including the condition of the jawbone, overall oral health, and individual patient factors, which are assessed during consultation.

Root canal treatment is a procedure aimed at addressing problems within the inner portion of an affected tooth. The goal is to preserve the natural tooth where clinically appropriate, rather than extracting it.

Smile designing refers to the aesthetic planning and treatment focused on improving the appearance of the smile. This may involve procedures such as veneers, crowns, orthodontics or other cosmetic dental work, depending on the patient's goals and clinical suitability.
Can multiple dental treatments be planned together?

Yes, in cases where multiple dental concerns need to be addressed, treatments can be coordinated as part of a comprehensive treatment plan. The sequence and approach will depend on your specific condition and priorities.
